This is my small groundnut plot that I intercrop with some maize along the edges. I will spread manure on it because my cattle provide that, but I cannot afford chemical fertilizer for this plot when my main maize field needs it more. My family will do all the work by hand as we always have, weeding when the rains come and harvesting when the crops are ready.
